description.purpose: The root of a colony whose OS is DECLARED rather than checked in: one empty hive, one edge, and one `cell.type: "ref"` marker in `os/`. Not one cell is written here -- the whole shell arrives on the first boot, out of the template library, through the very resolution and staging a mutation takes.
description.use_when: As the --root of stage one. It is a checked-in file and never the output of a scaffolding script: a root tree somebody generates is a tree nobody can diff, and the two things that make it a colony rather than a directory -- the marker and this one edge -- are precisely the two a generator would silently get wrong.
description.not_in_scope: No broker, no control loop, no authoring path, no front door and no organisation: none of that is written here, all of it is instantiated. And no drain for `error`, `reject` or `receipt` -- an emission nobody consumes localises itself in the dead-letter queue with its sender and its trace, which is a record; a cell that accepts it and drops it would be a silence with a name on it (GH #284).
description.contract_in: None. The root of a colony is addressed by path, not by lane.
